user.title: Sungrow Energy Manager settings
user.description: Choose the Sungrow entities used for grid export control and optional morning discharge. Optional discharge fields must all be configured before that feature can run.

data.reserve_soc_entity: Battery Reserved SoC for Backup entity (%)

data_description.export_entity: Live power being exported to the grid, in watts. Grid Target uses this value to decide when to change the battery charging limit.
data_description.charge_entity: Writable number entity that sets the battery charging power limit, in watts. Grid Target adjusts it in steps after the configured delay.
data_description.scene_entity: Scene to activate when starting Grid Target and when morning forced discharge ends. Choose Self-Consumption Mode (max battery discharge).
data_description.soc_entity: Current battery charge percentage. Morning discharge starts only when SOC is above the configured Empty SOC threshold and backup reserve.
data_description.reserve_soc_entity: Actual Sungrow Battery Reserved SoC for Backup value. The controller stops forced discharge when the battery reaches this percentage.
data_description.forced_scene_entity: Scene that puts the inverter into Battery Forced Discharge mode. Only used by the optional morning discharge schedule.
data_description.forced_power_entity: Writable number entity for Battery forced charge discharge power. The controller sets this value before activating the forced discharge scene.

remove.title: Remove Sungrow Grid PID
remove.description: An existing Sungrow Grid PID entry was found, even if it is hidden from the integrations list. Confirm removal of the entry and its entities. Other integrations will not be affected.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Sungrow Grid PID is already installed.
abort.removed_successfully: Sungrow Grid PID entry removed. You can uninstall its files through HACS.

error.charge_range: Invalid charge control range: max must be greater than min
